title: Curry Chicken with Coconut Cream
description: Tender chicken in a rich, creamy coconut curry sauce. Simple, comforting, and packed with flavour.

ingredients.notes: or breast fillets, both cut into bite-sized pieces
optional, mixed with 30ml water for thicker sauce

method.instruction: Heat oil in a large frying pan or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.

Add chicken pieces and cook until browned on all sides. If using thigh, cook for 5-6 minutes. If using breast, cook for 2-3 minutes only — just to brown, not cook through. Remove chicken and set aside.
In the same pan, add onion, garlic, and ginger. Cook for 2-3 minutes until softened.
Add curry powder and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in water, crumble in the stock cube, and stir to dissolve. Bring to a simmer.
Return chicken to the pan. If using thigh, cover and simmer for 15 minutes. If using breast, simmer for 5-8 minutes only — breast overcooks quickly.
Stir in coconut cream and simmer for another 5 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Season with salt to taste. For a thicker sauce, add cornflour slurry and stir until thickened.

notes.title: Thigh vs Breast
notes.content: Thighs are more forgiving and stay tender with longer cooking. Breast requires shorter cooking time — brown quickly and simmer for only 5-8 minutes to avoid drying out.

notes.title: Curry Powder Strength
notes.content: Start with 2 tablespoons of curry powder and add more to taste. Different brands vary in heat and flavour intensity.

notes.title: Coconut Cream vs Coconut Milk
notes.content: Coconut cream gives a richer, thicker sauce. You can substitute with coconut milk for a lighter version.

notes.title: Leftovers
notes.content: Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. The flavours deepen overnight.

notes.title: Add Vegetables
notes.content: Add diced potato, carrot, or peas during the last 10 minutes of cooking for a heartier meal.

notes.title: Black Pepper
notes.content: Add ground black pepper to taste when serving.
